name: JAC Japan resources: custom rows, tech gates, year-driven site release (20 km)

steps.code: BuildHeadlessGameSetup(); g_GameParameters:FullRefresh(); GameConfiguration.SetValue('JAC_RESOURCES_TEST_YEAR', 1541); HideGameSetup(); return 'setup built; calendar test year 1541 on turn 1'

local w,h=Map.GetGridSize(); if w~=154 or h~=67 then error('map grid mismatch '..w..'x'..h) end; for _,id in ipairs({'RESOURCE_JAC_GOLD','RESOURCE_JAC_LACQUER'}) do local r=GameInfo.Resources[id]; if not r then error('missing resource '..id) end; if r.PrereqTech then error(id..' must not be gated by a tech') end end; for r in GameInfo.Resources() do if r.PrereqTech and not string.find(r.PrereqTech,'TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official tech gate on '..r.ResourceType..': '..r.PrereqTech) end end; if GameInfo.Resources['RESOURCE_IRON'].PrereqTech~='TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_IRON_FORGING' then error('iron gate') end; for r in GameInfo.Resource_Harvests() do if r.PrereqTech and not string.find(r.PrereqTech,'TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official tech harvest gate on '..r.ResourceType) end; if r.ResourceType=='RESOURCE_RICE' and r.PrereqTech~='TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_IRRIGATION_WORKS' then error('rice harvest gate '..tostring(r.PrereqTech)) end end; local hills=false; for r in GameInfo.Resource_ValidTerrains() do if r.ResourceType=='RESOURCE_SILVER' and r.TerrainType=='TERRAIN_GRASS_HILLS' then hills=true end end; if not hills then error('silver is not valid on grass hills') end; local counts={}; for index=0,w*h-1 do local t=Map.GetPlotByIndex(index):GetResourceType(); if t>=0 then local name=GameInfo.Resources[t].ResourceType; counts[name]=(counts[name] or 0)+1 end end; for name,expected in pairs({RESOURCE_JAC_GOLD=2,RESOURCE_JAC_LACQUER=1,RESOURCE_SILVER=1}) do if counts[name]~=expected then error(name..' on map: '..tostring(counts[name])..', expected '..expected) end end; return 'custom resources defined, tech gates Sengoku-only, start resources on the map'

local w,h=Map.GetGridSize(); if w~=154 or h~=67 then error('map grid mismatch '..w..'x'..h) end; local sites={{'silver-ikuno',6089,'RESOURCE_SILVER',1542},{'silver-sado-tsurushi',6112,'RESOURCE_SILVER',1542},{'copper-ashio',4416,'RESOURCE_COPPER',1550},{'gold-izu-toi',3483,'RESOURCE_JAC_GOLD',1577},{'gold-noto-hodatsu',5948,'RESOURCE_JAC_GOLD',1586},{'lacquer-aizu',4882,'RESOURCE_JAC_LACQUER',1590},{'gold-sado-aikawa',5958,'RESOURCE_JAC_GOLD',1596},{'silver-nobesawa',5196,'RESOURCE_SILVER',1596}}; local shown=0; for _,s in ipairs(sites) do local t=Map.GetPlotByIndex(s[2]):GetResourceType(); if s[4]<=1541 then if t~=GameInfo.Resources[s[3]].Index then error('site not released: '..s[1]) end; shown=shown+1 elseif t~=-1 then error('site released too early: '..s[1]) end end; return 'year 1541: '..shown..' of '..#sites..' deferred sites on the map'
